context_granularity: A fresh responding agent per batch; each agent handles multiple independent prompts. This is not one fresh context per case. Review and targeted correction used separate contexts.
evaluation_method: Prompt-only execution agents read suite guidance without rubrics, prior verdicts or development history; root manually scores complete retained responses against required and forbidden semantic behaviors.
model_disclosure: All responding agents inherited the session model; no cross-model replication or separately reported model build identifier.
limitations: Bounded documentation behavior evaluation on authored fixtures, not a controlled version-to-version efficacy study or real manuscript/experiment/figure-runtime test. No installation or client discovery was tested. The accepted set combines unaffected original batch cases, one corrected provenance retest, four fresh suite-only figure cases, and one new companion-argument regression after a source-review fix. A whole-suite fresh rerun was not repeated after localized source edits. General navigation and source-attribution edits followed initial batches; final hashes identify delivered source, not an initially frozen test snapshot.
